image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, earthy surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Short, stout limbs are visible, particularly the front left limb which shows distinct digits. The tail curves around the body, appearing laterally compressed.
